title: Juicebox (PeopleGPT) - AI-native natural-language candidate sourcing
clean_text: Juicebox AI is an AI-native candidate sourcing platform built around PeopleGPT, which uses natural language search across more than 800 million candidate profiles from 30+ data sources, letting recruiters type prompts like "Senior Python Engineer in San Francisco with 5+ years at Apple or Amazon" instead of writing Boolean search strings, with the candidate population updating in real time as search criteria are tuned. Juicebox (PeopleGPT) crossed $10 million in annual recurring revenue and raised a $30 million Series A from Sequoia Capital in 2025, targeting recruiters and talent-sourcing teams who prioritize speed and flexible AI-assisted search.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-seat plus AI add-on
